name: Beneath Her Starry Sky
source:
The world is trapped in an endless time loop, and a terrible beast brings ruin over and over again. Dive into a simulated point in history to gather answers on breaking the cycle.

As Freya Fae, track down the master assassin Orick Genn before he brings ruin to the city of Ironfall. Rely on your faithful companions and make friends with the citizens as you encounter dangers lurking through the streets. To save the future, you must defend the past.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2241220/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界被困在无尽的时间循环之中，一头可怕的巨兽一次又一次带来毁灭。潜入模拟出的历史节点，搜集打破这一循环的答案吧。

你将扮演芙蕾雅·费伊，在刺客大师奥里克·格恩毁灭铁落城之前追查他的下落。在应对潜伏于街头巷尾的重重危机时，依靠你忠实的伙伴，并与城中居民结交。为了拯救未来，你必须守护过去。

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2241220/]Steam[/url]]
